The upstream files listed in upstream.json are vendored unchanged. COPYRIGHT,
redistribution conditions and disclaimer are retained in COPYING and each
upstream source file. This includes the compact trained weights distributed
as source in the original repository; no synthetic or replacement model was
generated for Sculpt Clean. No model download is required at build or runtime.

Sculpt's C++ adapter and CMake integration are separate from upstream files.
The adapter serializes and primes RNNoise's shared FFT initialization during
prepare(), converts normalized float audio to RNNoise's PCM-scale floats, and
aligns dry/wet paths with a 960-sample streaming delay at 48 kHz.

This is the original compact v0.1 model, not the current v0.2 RNNoise model.
It is trained for speech noise suppression and is not a music separator,
multi-speaker separator, dereverberator or implementation of iZotope software.
